title: What It Actually Looks Like to Judge Yourself Harder Than Anyone Else
caption:
A man of God judges himself first. Everyone else gets the mercy he had to earn.

Most guys run it backwards: soft on their own sin, sharp with their girlfriend, their mom, their brother. Flip the default.

Jesus wept with the grieving. He also flipped tables in his Father's house. He never confused the two.

Judge yourself like it matters. Judge him like he's still becoming.

#manofgod #christianmen #humility #selfdiscipline #gentleness #biblicalmanhood
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
